4490-6825--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4490-6825--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
MJ triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
4490-6825--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

1768-4153-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

2122-5042-7811.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Iron Man triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7297-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7297-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2292-2595--5.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1458-1976-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-1976-4404.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Etherium Sculptor.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

423-872-1437-5621--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-872-1437-5621--85.description:
Cast Scaled Herbalist by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Scaled Herbalist spell three times.
Resolve the first Scaled Herbalist copy.
Activate the Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
Arid Archway enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

877-2897-6967.description:
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Honest Rutstein.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Gigantoplasm triggers, returning Honest Rutstein from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Honest Rutstein by paying {0} due to Morophon and Gigantoplasm.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Honest Rutstein triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

245-1069-5499-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
245-1069-5499-7175.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to an Astartes Warrior.
Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

4050-6517-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4676-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Elegant Edgecrafters.
When Elegant Edgecrafters dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Elegant Edgecrafters enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4195-4211-4574-5243.description:
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2173-2292-5220-5933.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2946-4050-4619.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4050-4619.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}
When Cult Conscript dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 white Spirit creature token
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat

1669-3875-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1669-3875-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner trigger that many times.
Resolve all Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens, and then an additional Clue or Treasure token for each remaining trigger.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

3263-3750-4499-6300.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 8 life total this turn.
3263-3750-4499-6300.description:
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Megatron, Tyrant triggers, causing you to convert it into Megatron, Destructive Force and to add an amount of {C} equal to the life your opponents have lost this turn.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Megatron, Destructive Force and causing it to enter the battlefield as Megatron, Tyrant.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat during your next postcombat main phase.

116-5329-5361.notablePrerequisites:
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Auton Soldier do not have summoning sickness.
116-5329-5361.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Auton Soldier.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Auton Soldier.
Activate Auton Soldier by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Auton Soldier ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

955-2034-2820-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

804-1459-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Sakashima the Impostor. Choose to have Sakashima the Impostor enter as a copy of Galadriel.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters, Galadriel triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Galadriel.
When Galadriel enters, Sakashima the Impostor triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2034-2658-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Charforger, adding {C}{C}.
Charforger dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Charforger from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Charforger enters the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Phyrexian Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3013-3774-4499.notablePrerequisites:
Luxior attached to Nissa.
You control two creatures and two lands that can tap to produce at least {5}.
3013-3774-4499.description:
Activate two creatures and two lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, untapping those creatuers and lands.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Nissa.
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Nissa.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat but activate Nissa's second loyalty ability instead in step 2, and you may activate Emiel any number of times.

779-833-2546-5184.description:
Activate Soul of Windgrace's second ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace ability, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

23-776-1329-4671.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
23-776-1329-4671.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Accorder's Shield to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Accorder's Shield.
Cast Accorder's Shield.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

224-2210-5196.notablePrerequisites:
At least one basic land in hand.
Mirrormade is a copy of Retreat to Coralhelm.
Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
224-2210-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's first ability, putting a basic land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The Retreat to Coralhelms trigger.
In response, activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Let the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger resolve, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's last ability, returning any basic land you control from the battlefield to your hand.
Let the second Retreat trigger resolve, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Repeat.

3249-4659-5004.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
Cathodion triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Cathodion.
Cast Cathodion from graveyard by paying {3}.
Repeat.
